## What's new

Threadnote 5.4.2 makes sure Context Brief citations are validated, even when memory recall is slow on a large memory corpus.

### Validated citations after slow recall

In 5.4.1, memory recall and citation validation shared one 5-second read budget. Validation runs after recall, so a slow recall could use the whole budget, and the brief then came back with no validated citations.

Memory recall now stops early enough to leave citation validation time to finish. Recall still has more time than it had before 5.4.1.
